message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This primary product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; obvious aliases and duplicate entries were consolidated, and `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read. The scan window was **2026-10-08 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-09 23:40 UTC** (**2026-10-09 05:10 IST through 2026-10-10 05:10 IST**).

Twelve credible in-window findings were retained: seven in the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep, four affecting optional WordPress plugins, and one newly issued exploitation alert for legacy ONLYOFFICE Docs. No other monitored product produced a fresh, credible match after freshness and product checks.

### Finding 1 — CVE-2021-3199

- **Affected product/component:** ONLYOFFICE Docs / Document Server before 5.6.3
- **Severity:** High Risk (HKCERT); CVSS 9.8 is listed by CISA KEV reporting
- **Description:** HKCERT reported on October 9 that this older path-traversal flaw is being exploited in the wild. When JWT is used, a crafted image-upload path can enable security-control bypass and remote code execution.
- **Why relevant:** ONLYOFFICE is explicitly monitored. This is a new exploitation alert, not a newly assigned CVE.
- **Source:** [HKCERT bulletin](https://www.hkcert.org/security-bulletin/onlyoffice-docs-remote-code-execution-vulnerability_20261009) and [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?field_cve=CVE-2021-3199)

### Finding 2 — CVE-2026-104797

- **Affected product/component:** WordPress Advanced Form Integration plugin 2.9.0 and earlier
- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS 9.8
- **Description:** An unauthenticated password-change flaw in a Contact Form 7-to-Ultimate Member profile-update workflow can lead to authentication bypass and privilege escalation.
- **Why relevant:** WordPress is monitored; exposure is conditional on this plugin and integration being installed.
- **Source:** [Patchstack advisory](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/advanced-form-integration/vulnerability/wordpress-advanced-form-integration-plugin-2-9-0-unauthenticated-unverified-password-change-to-authentication-bypass-privilege-escalation-via-contact-form-7-submission-to-ultimate-member-update-profile-field-action-vulnerability)

### Finding 3 — CVE-2026-108125

- **Affected product/component:** WordPress WP Post Author plugin 4.0.0 through versions before 4.1.0
- **Severity:** Medium; CVSS v3 6.5 / CVSS v4 7.1
- **Description:** Unsafely stored co-author values are later interpolated into a SQL query, allowing a privileged WordPress user to perform second-order SQL injection and disclose data.
- **Why relevant:** WordPress is monitored; exposure is conditional on WP Post Author being installed.
- **Source:** [Tenable TRA-2026-62](https://www.tenable.com/security/research/tra-2026-62)

### Finding 4 — CVE-2026-108124

- **Affected product/component:** WordPress WP Post Author plugin before 4.1.0
- **Severity:** Medium; CVSS v3 4.1 / CVSS v4 6.9
- **Description:** Authenticated REST handlers concatenate attacker-controlled request parameters into SQL queries, allowing blind SQL injection and disclosure of database information.
- **Why relevant:** WordPress is monitored; exposure is conditional on WP Post Author being installed.
- **Source:** [Tenable TRA-2026-61](https://www.tenable.com/security/research/tra-2026-61)

### Finding 5 — CVE-2026-18496

- **Affected product/component:** WordPress Booking Calendar plugin 11.4.3 and earlier
- **Severity:** CVSS 5.3
- **Description:** An unauthenticated AJAX action can expose sensitive booking information. Patchstack characterizes the issue as low priority.
- **Why relevant:** WordPress is monitored; exposure is conditional on Booking Calendar being installed.
- **Source:** [Patchstack advisory](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/booking/vulnerability/wordpress-booking-calendar-plugin-11-4-3-unauthenticated-sensitive-information-exposure-in-wpbc-flextimeline-nav-ajax-action-vulnerability)

### Finding 6 — CVE-2026-87110

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Ops Manager 7.0.23 and earlier; 8.0 before 8.0.27
- **Severity:** CVSS v4 6.9
- **Description:** An unauthenticated network user can repeatedly request monitoring endpoints and consume resources, potentially degrading Ops Manager availability.
- **Why relevant:** Ops Manager is an official MongoDB component included in the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 7 — CVE-2026-87109

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Ops Manager 7.0.23 and earlier; 8.0 before 8.0.27
- **Severity:** CVSS v4 6.0
- **Description:** An authenticated organization member can retrieve another member's pending MFA enrollment seed while enrollment remains unconfirmed.
- **Why relevant:** Ops Manager is an official MongoDB component included in the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 8 — CVE-2026-87108

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Ops Manager 7.0.23 and earlier; 8.0 before 8.0.27
- **Severity:** CVSS v4 2.3
- **Description:** A read-only project user can retrieve daily host-monitoring information without the intended authorization.
- **Why relevant:** Ops Manager is an official MongoDB component included in the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 9 — CVE-2026-107325

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Go Driver 1.1.0 through 1.17.10; 2.x before 2.9.2
- **Severity:** High, CVSS v4 8.2
- **Description:** Missing BSON array-length validation can trigger an out-of-bounds index panic and terminate an application that validates attacker-supplied malformed BSON.
- **Why relevant:** The Go Driver is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [NVD record](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-107325) and [CSIRT-Italia-linked alert](https://csirt.regione.toscana.it/aggiornamenti-di-sicurezza-per-prodotti-mongodb-al04-261009-csirt-ita/)

### Finding 10 — CVE-2026-107324

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Go Driver 1.x before 1.2.0; 2.x before 2.9.0
- **Severity:** High, CVSS v4 8.2
- **Description:** Integer overflow in BSON value-length handling can cause a runtime panic and application denial of service when malformed BSON is validated or accessed.
- **Why relevant:** The Go Driver is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) and [CSIRT-Italia-linked alert](https://csirt.regione.toscana.it/aggiornamenti-di-sicurezza-per-prodotti-mongodb-al04-261009-csirt-ita/)

### Finding 11 — CVE-2026-106433

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB `libmongocrypt` 1.1.0 through versions before 1.20.5
- **Severity:** High, CVSS v4 8.7
- **Description:** Duplicate `masterKey` fields can cause state confusion, invalid memory access, and heap corruption in the client process.
- **Why relevant:** `libmongocrypt` is an official MongoDB encryption library covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) and [CSIRT-Italia-linked alert](https://csirt.regione.toscana.it/aggiornamenti-di-sicurezza-per-prodotti-mongodb-al04-261009-csirt-ita/)

### Finding 12 — CVE-2026-106429

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB `libmongocrypt` 1.1.0 through versions before 1.20.5
- **Severity:** High, CVSS v4 7.1
- **Description:** A malformed KMS endpoint can trigger integer underflow, allocation failure, and termination of an affected application process.
- **Why relevant:** `libmongocrypt` is an official MongoDB encryption library covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [NVD record](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-106429) and [CSIRT-Italia-linked alert](https://csirt.regione.toscana.it/aggiornamenti-di-sicurezza-per-prodotti-mongodb-al04-261009-csirt-ita/)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and libraries, MongoDB-owned advisories, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, CISA sources, and credible national CERT alerts. Other October 8 driver records were excluded because their date-only publication metadata did not prove that they fell inside this run's rolling 24-hour window.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for internet-facing legacy ONLYOFFICE Docs and any WordPress deployment using Advanced Form Integration. MongoDB Go Driver and `libmongocrypt` deployments should also be inventoried promptly because four newly surfaced issues carry High CVSS v4 scores. The remaining findings are conditional on the named component and affected version being present.
